title: What is the initial information architecture of the application shell?
statement: The first slice must choose which views exist: project overview, stage view, artifact tracker, assertion/evidence view, or some subset. The choice determines what the vertical slice has to render and what it may defer.
notes: The vertical slice as scoped needs a stage view at minimum, because it displays the current stage and one stage document. `app/server.mjs` already renders an assertion/evidence view against the same substrate, so that view has a working reference implementation and is the cheapest to reach parity on — which is an argument about ORDER, not about what the first slice must contain.
